generate_image_pair_commands: run the script to generate commandlines for creating image pairs from metadata JSON files in a directory
batch_process_metadata_files: run the script with an input directory to batch process all metadata.json files recursively
skip_existing_scenes: run the script to skip scenes where the output metadata.json file already exists
prefix_commandlines: run the script with a prefix argument to prepend environment setup commands to each generated commandline
generate_habitat_sim_commands: run the script to generate habitat simulator commandlines pointing to generate_from_metadata.py for each scene
